item.text: What's your main concern today? Please describe what's been happening.
When did this start, and has it been getting better, worse, or staying the same?
On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate the severity right now?
Are you experiencing any of the following: shortness of breath, chest tightness, fever, nausea, dizziness, or weakness on one side?
Do you have any history of similar symptoms, or any recent illness, injury, or surgery?
Have you tried anything to manage this so far — any medications or home remedies?
